parameters.formDescription: Upload a job description and candidate resumes to automatically shortlist top candidates using AI analysis. The assistant will match resumes against the job description and send personalized reports to your email.

parameters.text:
=AI Prompt for Resume-Job Match Analysis (Minimal Output)

Role: AI Recruitment Assistant

Goal: Analyze a candidate’s resume against a job description and provide a concise structured JSON containing only candidate name, email, match score, and reasoning.

Inputs:

resumeText: {{ $json["text"] }}

jobDescription:{{ $('On form submission').item.json['Job Description :'] }}

Instructions:

Extract candidate information from the resume:

candidateName → full name of the candidate

candidateEmail → email address

Analyze the resume against the job description based on:

Skills match

Experience relevance

Education fit

Overall suitability

Provide a match score from 1 to 10 (decimals allowed).

Include concise reasoning explaining the score.

Ensure deterministic scoring: same resume + job description → same score.

Respond strictly in valid JSON format with only the required fields:

{
  "candidateName": "<extracted from resume>",
  "candidateEmail": "<extracted from resume>",
  "score": <number between 1 and 10>,
  "reasoning": "<concise explanation of the match>"
}


Example Output:

{
  "candidateName": "Kiran Devi",
  "candidateEmail": "kiran.devi@example.com",
  "score": 9.0,
  "reasoning": "The candidate has strong full-stack development experience with React and Node.js, closely matching the job requirements. Cloud experience is partially mentioned."
}

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.item; // If binary data exists directly 
const binaries = item.binary ? Object.keys(item.binary) : []; // If no binary data found, stop with error 
if (binaries.length === 0) { throw new Error("No binary files found in input. Check previous node output."); } // Create an array for each file 
return binaries.map(key => ({ binary: { data: item.binary[key], }, json: { fileName: key, }, }));
